FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE Contact:Ashley Brittain ashley@nsgroupidaho.com Idaho's Constitutional Officers Unite Behind Sen. Jim Guthrie's Re-Election in Legislative District 28 Inkom, ID— May 5, 2026— The campaign to re-elect State Senator Jim Guthrie is proud to announce that five of Idaho's statewide constitutional officers have come together to endorse Sen. Guthrie's re-election to the Idaho Senate in Legislative District 28. The endorsements come from Governor Brad Little, Lieutenant Governor Scott Bedke, Superintendent of Public Instruction Debbie Critchfield, Secretary of State Phil McGrane, and State Controller Brandon Woolf — a unified show of support from the leaders Idahoans trust most to guide the direction of Idaho. "This election is an opportunity to keep strong, dependable leadership in the Idaho Senate, and that means supporting Sen. Jim Guthrie," said Governor Brad Little. "He reduces red tape, supports law enforcement, and fights for lower taxes. Jim has my complete endorsement for re-election on May 19th." Superintendent of Public Instruction Debbie Critchfield also voiced her strong support for Sen. Guthrie's re-election. "Senator Jim Guthrie's steady, principled leadership is exactly what Idaho needs. Jim understands a fundamental truth: public education is the fuel for Idaho's economy. By investing in our students today, he is building the skilled workforce our businesses need for tomorrow. He masterfully balances fiscal discipline with the real-world needs of our communities. value his deep experience and his unwavering commitment to the policies that keep Idaho's economy, and our families, thriving." said Superintendent Debbie Critchfield. Sen. Guthrie expressed his deep appreciation for the overwhelming support of Idaho's top elected leaders. "I am truly humbled and grateful to have the support of Governor Little, Lt. Governor Bedke, Superintendent Critchfield, Secretary McGrane, and Controller Woolf," said Sen. Jim Guthrie. "These are leaders I have had the privilege of working alongside to deliver real results for Idaho — lower taxes, less government overreach, stronger support for our law enforcement, and policies that respect the values of hardworking families. But at the end of the day, this campaign isn't about endorsements — it's about the people of District 28. They are the ones I answer to, they are the ones I fight for every single day at the Statehouse, and earning their trust is the

# Page 2^page=2
highest honor of my service. I'm asking for that trust again on May 19th so we can keep moving Idaho in the right direction." Sen. Guthrie has built a record of conservative, common-sense leadership in the Idaho Senate, championing fiscal responsibility, agriculture, public safety, and the rural communities that make District 28 a special place to call home. Voters in Legislative District 28 will head to the polls on Tuesday, May 19th for the Idaho Republican Primary Election. To learn more about Sen. Jim Guthrie and his campaign for re-election, visit GuthrieforIdaho.com or follow the campaign on social media. Paid for by Guthrie for Idaho
